title: Bitcoin Faces 6-Year Moving Average Test Only Seen During FTX Collapse
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Faces 6-Year Moving Average Test Only Seen During FTX Collapse Since 2016, the only time Bitcoin closed below its six-year moving average was the FTX crash.
